The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46caabb465529133), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are pairwise disjoint open balls U0, U+ k , U− k centered at 0, ak, −ak, respec- tively, and a bounded continuous function u : U → R, where U = U0 ∪ U+ 1 ∪ U− 1 ∪ U+ 2 ∪ U− 2 , such that c(x1, x2, x3) ≥ 3 X i=1 u(xi) on U3 . (7) Equality holds precisely at the triples in U3 which, after a permutation, have the form (Xk(y), y, Zk(y)) ∈ U0 × U+ k × U− k , y ∈ U+ k , k ∈ {1, 2}. (8) The maps Xk, Zk are diffeomorphisms on U+ k , with Xk(U+ k ) ⊂ U0, Zk(U+ k ) ⊂ U− k .
